discending paper partition chromatograph.translation: [化] 下行纸分配色谱; 下行纸分配色谱法

discept.definition: v. i. To debate; to discuss.

discern.translation: v. 辨别, 看清楚, 了解

discernable.definition: a perceptible by the senses or intellect
discernable.translation: a. (=discernible)可辨别的, 可认识的

discerned.translation: v. 看见( discern的过去式和过去分词 ); 辨明; 觉察出; 识别

discerner.definition:
n. One who, or that which, discerns, distinguishes,
   perceives, or judges; as, a discerner of truth, of right and wrong.

discernible.definition:
a. perceptible by the senses or intellect
s. capable of being perceived clearly
s. capable of being seen or noticed
discernible.translation:
a. 看得清的, 可看出的, 可辨别的, 辨别得出的
[计] 可识别的

discernibleness.definition: n. The quality of being discernible.

discernibly.definition: adv. In a manner to be discerned; perceptibly; visibly.

discerning.definition:
a. having or revealing keen insight and good judgment
s. unobtrusively perceptive and sympathetic
s. able to make or detect effects of great subtlety; sensitive
discerning.translation: a. 有眼力的, 敏锐的, 有辨别能力的, 有洞察力的

discerningly.definition:
adv. In a discerning manner; with judgment; judiciously;
   acutely.

discernment.definition: n. perception of that which is obscure
discernment.translation: [法] 认识, 识别, 洞察力

discerns.translation: v. 看见( discern的第三人称单数 ); 辨明; 觉察出; 识别

discerp.definition:
v. t. To tear in pieces; to rend.
v. t. To separate; to disunite.

discerptibility.definition: n. Capability or liableness to be discerped.

discerptible.translation: a. 可分解的, 可剖析的

discerption.definition:
n. The act of pulling to pieces, or of separating the
   parts.
discerption.translation: n. 分离, 断片, 割断
